body: The folded tarp and bath towel are wedged under unused warning tape. Footprints pass around the bundle rather than toward it.
title: Tarp and bath towel

body:
The caretaker says the grounds crew borrowed the kitchen sink for a rinse. Please keep the side room locked until the treated beds are dry; the folding chairs are still needed tomorrow.

The beds along the wall were sprayed that morning and the leaves already curl. I kept this page with the garden receipts, not the ordinary papers.
title: Letter
